titles.romaji: Fate/Grand Order: Fujimaru Ritsuka wa Wakaranai Season 2
titles.native: Fate/Grand Order 藤丸立香はわからない Season 2

description:
The second season of Fate/Grand Order: Fujimaru Ritsuka wa Wakaranai.
Ritsuka Fujimaru is humanity's last Master. Restoring humanity would have been impossible without him. However, even he has a shortcoming: he is honest to a fault! The FGO slapstick anime once again shows Fujimaru's naive questions throwing the Heroic Spirits into turmoil!

(Source: Official website)

Note: The last three episodes were aired as part of the Fate New Year's Eve TV Special 2024 on December 31, 2024. They were later made available on YouTube after January 11, 2025.
